title: Building D: utility D-A lost, farm auto start OFF
summary: The 35 kV utility feed of Building D path A is lost. The farm of path A was left with auto start OFF after a test, so it does not start. The hall rides on path D-B alone (2N lost). Start the farm of path A, put the rectifier group A input on it and set auto start back ON. Simulated plant (ADR-023): every timing and limit is a model value. Switching the procedure does not call for counts as a violation.

steps.text: Acknowledge the Building D path A alarms in the alarm banner
Start the generator farm of path A (Farm D-A: Start farm)
When the farm is on its bus, transfer the rectifier group A input to it
Check that path D-A carries load again (2N restored)
Set auto start of the farm D-A back ON
